_about: Questions ChemEZ answers from verified data before (or instead of) asking the AI model. Checked top to bottom; the first pattern that matches wins. {name}, {a} and {b} are compound names looked up locally or on PubChem. 'show' lists what the answer contains; 'ai' says what the model writes (never structures).
everything_else: D, E, H and other questions go to the model with the verified structures of any compounds they name (scenarios D/H). Formula-only questions (I) are handled by formula_only_question. Unknown or ambiguous names (F) get a clarification with the possible compounds.
